LESSON: WRITING 10.5.1 FILLING FORMS: APPLICATION FORMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.5: Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to fill in all parts of a form?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise bursary and scholarship application forms from a list of forms
2. value the importance of giving accurate and sufficient information in forms

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 10.5.1 FILLING FORMS: APPLICATION FORMS
This lesson teaches Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognise bursary and scholarship application forms from a list of forms
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. value the importance of giving accurate and sufficient information in forms
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms above.
2. Explain Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 10.5.1 Filling Forms: Application Forms important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to fill in all parts of a form?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise bursary and scholarship application forms from a list of forms
2. value the importance of giving accurate and sufficient information in forms
